m1.typescript: m1 who waits decides between real time and batch

e1.typescript: e1 a review has a pass for each file and then an integration pass

e2.typescript: e2 a review runs in a fresh session and is given the earlier findings

e3.typescript: e3 every claude command is headless json and bounded

e4.typescript: e4 the review can only read

e5.typescript: e5 the criteria name what to report what to skip and an example for each severity

e6.typescript: e6 the test prompt passes the existing tests and says what a useful test is

e7.typescript: e7 no file holds a personal path an address or a key

wrong-review-batch.defect: runs the blocking merge check as a batch

wrong-debt-realtime.defect: runs the overnight report in real time

wrong-single-pass.defect: reviews all files in one pass with no integration pass

wrong-integration-first.defect: puts the integration pass before the per-file passes

wrong-shared-session.defect: runs the review in the session that wrote the code

wrong-no-prior-findings.defect: gives a re-run no earlier findings

wrong-no-print-flag.defect: leaves the -p flag out of the review command

wrong-no-schema.defect: leaves the schema out of the review command

wrong-unbounded.defect: leaves the turn limit out of the review command

wrong-review-bash.defect: gives the review the Bash tool

wrong-allowed-edit.defect: approves the Edit tool in the review command

wrong-severity-free-text.defect: makes severity free text in the schema

wrong-no-suggestion.defect: stops requiring a suggestion in a finding

wrong-no-skip-list.defect: leaves out the list of what to skip

wrong-no-example.defect: leaves the high severity without an example

wrong-vague-criteria.defect: adds a vague instruction to be conservative

wrong-prompt-no-existing.defect: does not pass the existing tests to the test prompt

wrong-prompt-no-useful.defect: does not say what a useful test is

wrong-home-path.defect: writes a personal home path into the criteria
